title: Define data minimisation, aggregation, and retention contracts
businessObjective: Keep analytics useful without copying raw guest interaction telemetry into AI OS.
technicalObjective: Define static aggregate allowlists and configurable retention authorities for temporary ingestion, logs, AI artifacts, workflows, aggregates, incidents, and audit evidence.
assumptions: Raw page views, clicks, scrolls, and marketing telemetry remain in their source systems.
acceptanceCriteria: Contract allows only hourly/daily aggregates, essential booking lifecycle events, anomalies/incidents, investigations/recommendations, proposals/approvals/executions/outcomes, and required audit evidence.
It rejects a permanent row, queue message, workflow, or AI invocation per guest interaction.
Retention categories and actions define scheduled deletion, aggregation, archival, and future local transfer without rewriting audit/failed-attempt history.
Core receives classified/aggregated data through ports, never a provider storage SDK.
Tests cover allowlists, prohibited raw telemetry, retention conflicts, and fail-closed unknown categories.
requiredChecks: exact validator admission before independent verification
solEscalationTriggers: Any guest-data, retention, audit-deletion, storage-provider, or production-data ambiguity.
rollbackExpectations: Revert static contracts only and preserve evidence.

stateTransitions.reason: Created by GOV-043 for the required data authority.
